x: Those members who knew the late Bob Martin, one of our foremost distance walkers will be pleased to hear that his daughter Sheila is following in his footsteps and on November 3rd was 2nd in the Women's 2 miles National Junior Championship at Regents Park.

In the same race was Bob Martin, a policeman who also figured in many of our teams, and who clocked 22:16:57 to become No. 127. He was killed in an accident whilst on a motor-cycle patrol a few years later.
